factProposals.value: Maintenance must avoid service hours; the workspace uses Monday to Friday, 6:00 to 20:00 Central as the proposed definition.
MaintenanceWindow was added to the data model to record planned maintenance.

decisions.statement: Service levels by priority are proposed as 4, 8, 24 and 72 hours to a first answer.
decisions.rationale: The plan states none; one place holds them so the confirmed values replace them in one edit.

decisions.statement: A new ticket goes to the on-duty support person with the fewest open tickets.
decisions.rationale: Spreads the load and makes "support team unavailable" visible as an escalation.

limitations.statement: The system tracks and flags service levels; it cannot make people resolve in time. Service hours and service levels need TxDOT confirmation.
